neighbours.label: 'such as' / list connectors introducing examples of exercises or poses in fitness and health instructions
fire: During pregnancy, avoid poses that squeeze the belly, such as deep twists and full backbends.
Beginners can start with simple moves such as squats, lunges and push-ups.
Some stretches, such as hamstring curls and calf raises, ease knee pain.
Low-impact activities such as swimming and cycling are gentle on the joints.
Core exercises such as planks and bird dogs help protect the lower back.
If your shoulder hurts, skip lifts such as overhead presses and snatches.
Warm up with light drills such as jumping jacks and arm circles first.
Balance poses such as tree pose and warrior three build ankle strength.
quiet: During pregnancy, avoid poses that squeeze the belly, and ask your teacher for alternatives.
Beginners can start slowly and add a few minutes of training each week.
Gentle stretching after a run can ease knee pain for many people.
Low-impact activity is gentle on the joints and still good for the heart.
Strengthening the core helps protect the lower back during daily life.
If your shoulder hurts, rest it for a week before lifting again.
Warm up for ten minutes before any hard workout to avoid injury.
Practising balance every day builds ankle strength over time.

notes: Card: one outlier peak (334) on 'such as' before 'abdominal twists' in pregnancy yoga advice; the next peaks (about 100-110) are 'and', ':', ',' inside lists of exercises, and a few lab-method lists. Quiet items keep the exercise advice without an example list.
